description: LATERAL FLATTEN whose input is a FUNCTION-WRAPPED correlated column, as in FLATTEN(input => PARSE_JSON(tags)). The correlated column lives on the OUTER row, so the whole input expression must be evaluated with the lateral context in scope - a bare input => tags always worked, but the wrapped form previously failed with 'column not found'. The pipeline test stacks what a real loader does: a source over VALUES with auto-named columns, a FLATTEN of a parse_json'd correlated column that FANS OUT one outer row into several, a DENSE_RANK whose ORDER BY tie-breaks on the cast FLATTEN output, and string building over the result. A LATERAL join whose LEFT side has ZERO rows must return an empty result rather than crash: the right side's schema was only captured inside the per-left-row loop, so an empty left left the right table null and NPE'd downstream - covered for the comma form, the LEFT JOIN LATERAL form, and an empty lateral feeding an outer join. Converted 1:1 from query/LateralFlattenCorrelatedTest (now retired); the VALUES source is wrapped in a view so the auto-named COLUMN1..n reference the Java's CTE relied on is preserved.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE machines (name VARCHAR, tags VARCHAR)
SELECT name, f.value::VARCHAR AS tag FROM machines, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => parse_json(tags)) f ORDER BY name, tag
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW orders_v AS SELECT * FROM VALUES ('ORD1', 'alpha_team', '["red_hat","blue_sky"]', '50'), ('ORD2', 'beta_team', '["green_field"]', '75')

SELECT UPPER(REPLACE(column2,'_','-')) || '#' || UPPER(REPLACE(t.value::VARCHAR,'_','-')) || '#' || LPAD(TO_VARCHAR(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY column2, t.value::VARCHAR)), 3, '0') AS tag_id, column1 AS order_id, t.value::VARCHAR AS tag, column4::NUMBER AS score FROM orders_v, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => parse_json(column3)) t ORDER BY tag_id
CREATE TABLE empty_dev (id INT, installs ARRAY)
SELECT b.value FROM empty_dev r, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => r.installs) AS b
CREATE TABLE empty_dev2 (id INT, installs ARRAY)
SELECT b.value FROM empty_dev2 r LEFT JOIN LATERAL FLATTEN(input => r.installs) AS b
CREATE TABLE dim_sw (software_key VARCHAR, name VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE empty_src (id INT, installs ARRAY)

SELECT dest.name FROM (SELECT b.value::VARCHAR AS software_key FROM empty_src r, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => r.installs) AS b) source_data LEFT JOIN dim_sw AS dest ON dest.software_key = source_data.software_key
